source_license_evidence: Derivative listing says CC0; the underlying iammustafatz listing says Data files © Original Authors. Rights to the 100,000 copied rows are unresolved.
rights_basis: Explicit user authorization in the Codex conversation on 2026-11-03 for academic-research training of this local candidate. This project authorization does not independently relicense the underlying copied rows; the upstream license uncertainty is retained in known_limitations and review_note.
generation_method: Underlying observation-generation method is not documented by the source. The derivative description says clinical_notes are summaries based on patient attributes.
label_definition: Binary source column diabetes used as the supplied current-label target; the source does not specify the clinical diagnostic criteria used to define it.
label_generation_method: Not documented by the source; use the provided 0/1 values as supplied and retain this limitation.
label_leakage_review_notes: Observed proxy rule HbA1c >= 6.5 OR blood_glucose_level >= 126 catches 100% of adult positive labels. This does not prove the target-generation method; the source does not document how diabetes labels were assigned. With-labs metrics must not be treated as predictive-value evidence.
known_limitations: The derivative contains 100,000 rows that match the underlying iammustafatz dataset as a multiset, while the underlying listing states Data files © Original Authors; rights to copied rows are unresolved.
Whether observations include real patient data is unknown; the dataset description refers to data from patients and does not establish synthetic provenance.
The diabetes label definition and label-generation method are undocumented.
A simple HbA1c >= 6.5 OR glucose >= 126 proxy captures 100% of adult positive labels, indicating severe potential label leakage for with-labs models.
There is no person identifier; repeated feature and lab values cannot be verified as independent observations.
Adult records contain 18 gender=Other rows; subgroup metrics must be withheld below n=100.
Blood glucose has only 18 discrete values and no fasting/random/OGTT measurement type; units are implied as mg/dL.
clinical_notes, year, location, race indicators, HbA1c, and glucose are excluded from the six-feature no-labs model input.
review_note: User instruction: "dataset được dùng hãy triển khai" (2026-11-03), recorded as project authorization for academic-research no-labs training. Upstream rights to the copied source rows remain unverified; real-patient-data status remains unknown; label definition and generation method remain undocumented.
